name: agent-bemfa-notify
description: Push AI agent status (long task finished, needs your approval, API error) to a Bemfa MQTT topic, e.g. an ESP32 desk display. Hooks + an MCP tool (notify_board).

bemfa_uid.title: Bemfa private key (UID)
bemfa_uid.description: From the Bemfa console home page (cloud.bemfa.com). Stored in the system keychain. Leave empty to use `agent_notify.py setup` instead.

topic.title: MQTT topic
topic.description: Create it first in the Bemfa console (MQTT device cloud).

min_seconds.title: Only report turns longer than (seconds)
min_seconds.description: Short Q&A turns are not pushed.

device_name.title: Device name
device_name.description: Shown on the receiver. Defaults to the hostname.

privacy.title: Message content
privacy.description: full = include a one-line summary of the agent's last reply; minimal = only the status and project name.
